mapper.insert: insert into cr_warn_process (event_id,handler_id, process_type, process_content, process_result, follow_up_plan,process_time,status) values (#{eventId}, #{handlerId}, #{processType}, #{processContent}, #{processResult}, #{followUpPlan},#{processTime},#{status})
mapper.select: select * from cr_warn_process where event_id = #{eventId} order by process_time desc
mapper.update: update cr_warn_process set status = 1 where event_id = #{eventId} and status = 0
